title: Rated for bringing the India team into the re-architecture
summary: My review said I had built enough credibility with the US architecture team for the India team to become stakeholders in re-architecting the product. It also credited the My Accounts migration, the enrollment messaging proof of concept and how I led junior engineers.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: this is a performance review.
the_call: Earn the India team a place in the product's re-architecture through what we delivered.
what_i_did: Built credibility with the US architecture team, brought the India team into the re-architecture and helped the team move date-processing logic onto the API layer.
what_changed: Rated consistently exceeds expectations; the reviewers wrote that the junior team saw me as a role model.

quotes.text: Datta continues to build on the excellent foundation that he has laid.
The junior team, I believe sees him as a role model.
